findings.title: Add regression coverage for SQL-expression rejection
findings.body: This security-sensitive behavior is changed without any test covering it. Add tests that parse a SQL expression with `FlagSqlExpressions` both enabled and disabled and verify that it is rejected before `NewSQLCommand`/execution, plus coverage for the legacy `UnmarshalSQLCommand` path if it remains supported. Without this, a later refactor of the permanently-false helper or replacement of the stub DB can silently re-enable SQL execution and reintroduce the RCE/LFI attack surface.
